quarterly_data.quarter: Shin-Etsu Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 2025 (semi-annual report): net sales JPY 1,284,522 million (+1.4% YoY), operating income JPY 333,935 million (-17.7%), ordinary profit JPY 367,339 million (-17.1%), net income attributable to owners of parent JPY 257,844 million (-12.3%); management states this was 53% of the July full-year forecast for operating income and 55% for net income. Segments: Electronics Materials sales JPY 496,327 million (+6.9%), operating income JPY 170,696 million (-8.6%); Infrastructure Materials sales JPY 500,419 million (-1.8%), operating income JPY 102,393 million (-32.7%); Functional Materials sales JPY 220,643 million (-2.4%), operating income JPY 48,191 million (-10.5%); Processing, Trading & Specialized Services sales JPY 67,131 million (+0.9%), operating income JPY 13,656 million (-8.5%).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 sales JPY 1,284,522 million (+1.4%); OI JPY 333,935 million (-17.7%); Electronics Materials OI JPY 170,696 million (-8.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Shin-Etsu Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-13-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Management analysis (semi-annual report, first half to September 2025): in the semiconductor market AI-related demand stayed buoyant while demand in other areas remained lacklustre, so the company focused on shipping silicon wafers, photoresist, mask blanks and other semiconductor materials to the strongly growing markets; rare-earth magnets met firm hard-disk-drive demand while the company worked on responding to the export controls China imposed in reaction to US tariff policy. Demand for semiconductor-wafer containers was firm both for wafer shipping and for in-process use. Management states the new export controls China announced in early October are of a different dimension, as the reaction of the US government shows, and must be watched closely. H1 R&D expense was JPY 37,252 million.
